- [Validation Wave G — input-layer digit caps (Price 15 · User Limits 3 · browser-verified)](project_validation_input_caps_wave_g_2026_05_24.md) — 🟢 BROWSER-VERIFIED 2026-05-24 commit `12d3cb07`. Two-part Ammar directive: (1) Price Value (CommChannels Step 3 + Apps Step 4) cap bumped from 9 digits → 15 digits AND input layer hard-blocks the 16th keystroke; (2) Max Allowed in Account Limitations (Settings step + Info-page Settings tab in BOTH consoles) — block the 4th digit instead of auto-snapping to 999. Same fix pattern in both: switch `<falcon-angular-input-number>` / `<falcon-angular-input type="number">` → `<falcon-angular-input type="text" inputMode="numeric" [maxlength]=N>` because `type="number"` ignores HTML maxlength and `<falcon-angular-input-number>` auto-clamps silently. Setter strips non-digits + truncates to N as paste-defence + clamps to [0, HARD_CAP]. `PRICE_VALUE_MAX` bumped `999_999_999` → `999_999_999_999_999` (below Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, JS-safe). Tests 471/471 via vitest (+6 cases proving 1B/15-nine valid, 16-nine outOfRange). Browser-verified: typing "1234" caps "123"; pasting "99999" truncates to "999". **Rules emitted**: `<input type="number">` ignores `maxlength` — always use type=text + inputMode=numeric for char-count caps; `<falcon-angular-input-number>` silently auto-clamps — switch to `<falcon-angular-input>` for hard-block; two-layer enforcement (browser maxlength + setter strip/truncate/clamp) is canonical; `PRICE_VALUE_MAX=999_999_999_999_999` is below Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (9.007e15) — JS-safe without BigInt. **Out of scope**: xlsx still says max 999,999,999 for Price Value; FE numeric upper bound exceeds it now (Ammar override, follow-up xlsx alignment pending). - [Do-payment 502 root cause + FE console-noise hardening (G-24)](project_order_status_realtime_502_2026_05_21.md) — 🟢 INFRA-FIX + FE COMMIT 2026-05-21. Container `falcon-comm-realtime-1` started via `docker compose up -d comm-realtime`. FE hardening commit `a3a8eb53` on branch `fix/order-status-realtime-502` (off `polishing-v0.4`). **Root cause of 502** on `/hubs/order-status/negotiate?negotiateVersion=1`: System Gateway YARP route `realtime-hubs-proxy` (appsettings.json:98-103) forwards `/hubs/*` to `realtime-cluster` → `http://comm-realtime:8080` in docker / `http://host.docker.internal:5210` in dev (Development overrides:48-54). When the `falcon-comm-realtime-svc` container is NOT running, gateway error middleware (WebApplicationExtensions.cs:73-86) catches the connection failure and returns 502 with envelope `{isSuccessful:false, errorMessages:["Downstream service unavailable: ConnectionRefused"]}`. The realtime service hosts `OrderStatusHub` ([CODE] falcon-comm-realtime-svc/.../Realtime/OrderStatusHub.cs:31-113) — Kafka consumer subscribes to `commerce.order-finalized.v1`; do-payment flow: Commerce POST do-payment → 200 with orderId → FE joins SignalR group → Commerce emits Kafka after terminal → realtime svc pushes to group → FE handleTerminal. **FE polling fallback was ALREADY robust**: do-payment-priority-popup.component.ts:299-327 has 3 fallback layers — joinOrder.catch → immediate reconcile GET, bounded timer after pollTimeoutMs → reconcile, manual retry. User's payment WOULD have completed correctly via polling even with 502; status:1 (Pending) response in screenshot proves fallback was working. **G-24 FE hardening**: OrderStatusRealtimeService.onclose now downgrades transport failures (regex `/negotiate|gateway|502|503|504|network|failed to fetch|err_connection/i`) to `console.warn` with "polling fallback will handle it" message; true hub-side errors (auth drop, JoinOrder exception) stay `console.error`. Verified post-fix: `curl http://localhost:5210/health/ready` → 200; `curl gateway/hubs/order-status/negotiate` → 401 (proper auth required, not 502). User-reported "Apps & Services empty for Honda" — likely the 3s Wave 7 loading skeleton + footer count UX inconsistency (loader session territory). User-reported "users not loading for some nodes" — likely genuine BE empty data (no users assigned to that node OR role-filter excludes Falcon-typed users on a sub-node); needs network trace to diagnose further. Rules emitted: local stack `docker compose up` MUST include `comm-realtime` for SignalR push to work without polling fallback; FE transport failures on SignalR hub MUST log `console.warn` not error.

- [Falcon Studio MF eager-share — REAL root cause of calendar TDZ](project_falcon_studio_mf_eager_root_cause_2026_05_20.md) — 🟠 DIAGNOSED 2026-05-20 (NOT YET APPLIED — user holding). After 2 passes of @falcon/studio/runtime subpath splits (8 files flipped — host-shell apps + ui-core wrappers), `nx build host-shell` hash `1ce0a5f656348156` STILL has `container-nav-examples.ts` (module 37703 — exact ID from user's stack) at line 28706 of main.js. Why: `apps/host-shell/module-federation.config.ts:41-50` shares ALL `@falcon/*` with `eager: true`, which compiles to `register("@falcon/studio", "0.0.1", () => __webpack_require__(52876), 1)` at main.js:81559 (trailing `1` = eager flag). MF's `eager: true` forces the share into host's initial chunk regardless of static imports; the showcase route's `import('@falcon/studio')` resolves to that pre-loaded module via singleton sharing → boundary collapses. Why CALENDAR specifically (not Accordion/Tabs/Stepper in same file): inside angular-wrapper barrel (main.js:54759-54818) components hoisted `var = __webpack_require__(...)` execute in SOURCE order — tabs `_14`/stepper `_16`/accordion `_22` come early (lines 54767-54775), calendar `_44` is line 54801. Harmony getters register BEFORE assignments. When container-nav-examples reads through MF's synchronous eager-init, the first three find their `var` assigned but calendar's `var = require(86491)` is mid-stack on the require chain → its captured-by-reference closure returns undefined → `TypeError`. THE FIX: one-line special-case in `module-federation.config.ts` BEFORE the generic `@falcon/*` matcher → `if (libraryName === '@falcon/studio') { return { ..., eager: false }; }`. Then `@falcon/studio` gets its own webpack chunk and only loads when /falcon-ui-showcase activates. Build artifact + bundled chunk evidence captured in topic file. User declined to apply automatically — will apply themselves.

Add Client Step 3/4 priceType + priceValue cells rendered control at TOP of row band (control center y=17, cell center y=26) because `flex flex-col justify-center gap-1` centers the [control + reserved 14px error span] STACK, not the control alone. Unified `<th>` + `<td>` inline padding via single SoT token (`--falcon-table-header-padding-inline: var(--falcon-table-cell-padding-inline)` — was 17/20 mismatch); new opt-in `ColumnDef.headerInset` field renders inline `padding-inline-start: calc(cell-padding + Npx)` on `<th>` only; matrix at sm: dropdown=11, input(no iconLeft)=11, input(iconLeft)=0, switch/badge/text=0. 5 source files + 1 Brain Outputs dossier. - [Shadow-row price input padding + SAR-icon column fix](project_shadow_row_price_input_padding_fix_2026_05_20.md) — 🟢 BUILD-GREEN 2026-05-20 (final). Edit-Price shadow row: `inputClass="ps-8"` → `ps-2.5` and SAR overlay `start-[var(--falcon-data-table-cell-padding-x)]` → `start-[3px]`. Two coupled root causes — (1) Falcon spacing scale overrides Tailwind: `--spacing-8 = 3rem = 48px` (not 32 px), so `ps-8` ran away; (2) the legacy 14 px `--falcon-data-table-cell-padding-x` token still pinned the SAR glyph 14 px deeper than the parent-row glyph after today's v2 directive re-anchor. Final: glyph at `H + 23` (3 px breathing room from input border, 3 px column-drift from parent row glyph at `H + 20`); value text at `H + 39` with a 4 px icon-to-value gap matching parent row's `gap-1`. `nx build admin-console` PASS 27.1 s, hash `5e9d3420b974125f`.

## Feedback — Standing Rules
- [Never modify code or commit](feedback_never_modify_code_or_commit_2026_05_20.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-20. Never edit source, never commit, never even ask. All fix proposals go into a separate report file under `reports/`. The user — and only the user — applies changes.
- [PR review silent by default](feedback_pr_review_silent_default.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-19. PR reviews post nothing to the PR; silent review is default; always ask before any PR comment/attachment; HTML report + code evidence always.
- [API code stays in host app](feedback_api_code_stays_in_host_app.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-19. API-calling services/classes live in host-shell, never the library; library is presentation-only and grabs the class via DI.
- [Data table page size 10](feedback_data_table_default_page_size_10.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-18. Every Falcon data table defaults to page size 10.
- [Test-user password standard](feedback_test_user_password_standard.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-16. Every test/seed user in every Falcon env uses password `Admin@1234`.
- [PES g-link uses Zitadel id](feedback_pes_g_link_uses_zitadel_id.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-16. PES g-rule `obj` must be `u:<ZitadelUserId>@<ns>`, never MongoObjectId; else silent deny.
- [Orchestrator failure modes](feedback_orchestrator_failure_modes_org_hierarchy.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-15. 10 failure patterns + 10 locked rules. Read before any UI parity task.
- [Falcon library mandatory](feedback_falcon_custom_library_mandatory.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-15. Falcon library FIRST; strict customization order; Tailwind+tokens only.
- [Library-only, no native UI](feedback_falcon_ui_library_only_no_native.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-16. Only falcon-ui-core angular-wrapper; zero native interactive elements in apps/.
- [Skeleton + app-wrapper layers](feedback_library_skeleton_app_api.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-15. Two layers: library skeleton (presentational) + app wrapper (injects services).
- [No external API dependency](feedback_no_external_api_dependency.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-18. Never push for ChatGPT/Gemini keys; Claude + local files is enough.
- [Discard old UI repos](feedback_discard_old_ui.md) — Always exclude falcon-web-platform-ui-old and deprecated-falcon-web-platform-ui.
- [Canonical Falcon frontend repo](feedback_webstorm_duplicate_workspace.md) — 🔴 RULE 2026-05-19. Frontend repo is `C:\Falcon\Falcon\falcon-web-platform-ui` (the git working copy) — always. Never the WebstormProjects or `C:\Falcon\falcon-web-platform-ui` copies.
- [Self-explore, don't ask](feedback_self_explore.md) — Never ask user which path to take; pick the most interesting option and explore autonomously.
- [Auth via Identity Service](feedback_frontend_auth_identity_service.md) — Frontend NEVER calls Zitadel directly; all auth goes through Identity Service.
- [Wiki naming conventions](feedback_wiki_naming_conventions.md) — All Nx apps/libs/paths follow Wiki kebab-case + @falcon/* scope rules.
- [Tailwind grid-first](feedback_tailwind_grid_first.md) — Tailwind CSS Grid is the default layout primitive; flexbox only for small inline alignment.
- [No inline styles, tokens only](feedback_no_inline_styles_tokens_only.md) — Zero inline styles, tokens only; pre-finish grep gate codified.
- [Shadow tokens are SSOT](feedback_shadow_is_token_ssot.md) — Stencil Shadow + `<name>.tokens.css` are SSOT; Tailwind variant mirrors same tokens.
- [No UI testing while building](feedback_no_ui_testing_during_implementation.md) — No dev-serve/preview/browser verification during implementation; separate user-initiated phase.
- [Strict task scope](feedback_strict_task_scope.md) — Never edit infra/config/tooling outside task scope; stop and report broken external files.
- [Angular-only scope](feedback_angular_only_scope.md) — LOCKED 2026-05-08. Falcon UI Wave 3+ targets Angular wrapper only; skip React + Vue.
- [Always build zero errors](feedback_always_build_zero_errors.md) — After non-trivial changes, run `nx build <app>` and fix every error before reporting done.
- [Build must be green](feedback_build_must_be_green.md) — No phase ships red; dispatch a fix agent immediately on any `nx build` error.
- [Clean, DRY, minimal code](feedback_clean_code_dry_minimal.md) — Minimum code, clean, DRY, idiomatic; no duplication, no speculative abstractions.
- [Terse comment style](feedback_comment_style.md) — Terse banner-format comments only (`*** ... ***` delimited, max 2 lines), no verbose JSDoc.
- [Folder-structure pattern](feedback_folder_structure_pattern.md) — One file per type-folder (models/models.ts, services/services.ts, etc.).
- [`--` spawns parallel agent](feedback_double_dash_immediate_parallel.md) — Messages prefixed `--` spawn an agent immediately in parallel; strip the `--` before briefing.
- [Beep when input needed](feedback_beep_when_input_needed.md) — Long beep ONLY when user input is required to proceed; never on routine actions.
- [Orchestrator voice](feedback_orchestrator_voice.md) — Speak as orchestrator only; hide agent mechanics/IDs/briefs; concise outcome-focused replies.
- [Never push without permission](feedback_never_push_without_explicit_permission.md) — Never `git push`/open PRs unless user explicitly says "push".
- [Never commit without permission](feedback_never_commit_without_explicit_permission.md) — Never `git commit` unless user explicitly says "commit".
- [No commit/push strict](feedback_no_commit_no_push_strict_2026_05_02.md) — STRICT: never commit/push without "commit"/"push" in the CURRENT message.
